_comment: L13: the role of the owner-requested Fable step (router escalate-fable). model is the frontmatter fallback, the admitted orchestrator-tier model; the router sets Fable 5.1 only when the owner approves. Read-only: it writes nothing but its output (mcp__metodo__output_write) and its handoff, so it has no Write tool; may_write fences any write to the round directory. max_context_tokens 120000 matches the Fable entry's bounded context in config/model-tiers.json (Assumed, tunable). forbidden_paths only lists what's specific to this role; the project's shared build files and **/.claude/** are always forbidden.
